item.description: The Prince Albert executive committee will review new data on the city’s liquor store hours bylaw when it meets Monday, alongside a housing strategy presentation and several development-related requests. item.title: MLA raises child poverty concerns as province points to affordability supports
item.description: Saskatchewan has the highest child poverty rate in Canada, and Prince Albert is among the communities most affected, Cumberland MLA Jordan McPhail said. According to a report released this week by the Canadian Centre for Policy Alternatives, Saskatchewan has the highest child poverty rate among Canadian provinces, with 27.1 percent of children living in poverty.
